correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Cov(Q_F,Q_G)=4∑_{i<j}FijGij and spectral monotonicity via doubly-stochastic p_kl; n=2 has two ordered sign-response levels. In n=3 the eight sign vectors reduce to four equal-mass antipodal classes; Birkhoff/rearrangement says identity coupling maximizes covariance iff all six pairwise class differences agree in sign. Exact rational L²=[[21,24,14],[24,401,2],[14,2,13]], class responses and all 24 class permutations independently evaluated: shared contrast variance 62/9, second/third coordinate swap 2/9, ratio31; Gershgorin diagonal-dominance SPD and increasing f,g on positive spectrum. Actual verify_coupling.py checked structurally. No higher-dimensional optimality claimed.
